title: Signal Flags

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: We're home! As we sail into harbour, we fly a pattern of flags. It tells everyone ashore: all safe, all well.

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: Will you run up the flags? Mind the pattern, or they'll think we're in trouble!

steps.speaker: mara
steps.prompt: Carry on the pattern of flags. What comes next?

older.prompt: Carry on the pattern: red, blue, blue, yellow. What comes next?

feedback.all_good: All safe, all well! Look, they're waving from the quay.

outro.speaker: mara
outro.text: Welcome home, shipmate. You're a real sailor now: you've sailed, fished, explored and signalled. Thank you.

journal_line: I flew the signal flags as Captain Mara's ship came home.
